verdict.rationale: Viam documents versioning and rollback for ML models and OTA software/modules (inline modules have Viam-managed 'source code, builds, versioning, and deployment', and canary testing/rollbacks are offered for 'safe versioning'), which extends to automation logic deployed via modules. However there is no explicit evidence of a review/approval workflow for automations, and rollback evidence is framed mainly around ML models and fleet software updates rather than automation logic specifically. Missing for 10: explicit review/approval workflow for automations, direct hands-on evidence of rolling back a logic/automation module (not just ML models or generic OTA software).
